_comment: Cross-language fixture for the telemetry payload shape (0316).
Two serialisers produce these frames for the page and they are not shared:
key names, same clamp, same rounding — and, before this fixture, the same
comment about the stereo-linked detector, word for word in both files, with
Both sides now assert against this file: Rust in
`telemetry-payload.test.mjs`. Change one serialiser and one test fails.
Every input is exactly representable in f32, so the two languages agree
bit-for-bit after widening and there is no epsilon anywhere.
`meterIn` is MeterTap order — the order `MeterFrame::drain` writes and the
order the telemetry SAB carries: l1 L/R, l2 L/R, dynIn L/R, dynOut L/R,
_scopeComment: Rails and rounding, not a waveform: 2.5 and -3 must clamp to +/-2 (the
trace clips there anyway, and one runaway sample would otherwise bloat the
frame), and 0.0625 must round to 3 dp — the canvas is ~120 px tall, so
anything finer is invisible and full f32 printing would triple the length
of an array shipped 30x a second.
